dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: This is bad... This is really bad...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Oh, you're... the traveler. *sigh* You must have seen the storm that hit us, too. All of Mondstadt's a mess right now.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Cyrus said that we need to stop monsters from taking this opportunity to attack us. So he put out commissions for adventurers to scout their movements out.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: My next commission was to observe the monsters around the Thousand Winds Temple, so I confirmed my tasking and left.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: At the Temple, I saw a large group of monsters gathering together, and I tried to get a closer look...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: But I didn't expect to be discovered almost immediately upon getting closer. If a passing adventurer hadn't come to my rescue, I wouldn't have made it.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: We left the Thousand Winds Temple for fear of being attacked by more monsters, and came back to Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: And that's when I realized... that I had left my Adventurer Handbook and map at the Temple.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: But there's no way I can go to get it back like this...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Traveler, would you be willing to help me go to the Thousand Winds Temple and retrieve my map and Adventurer Handbook?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Thank you so much. *sigh* Honestly, it's a bit embarrassing...

choices.text: Why were you there in the first place...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Ugh, this is a bit embarrassing... Do you know of the Adventurer Rank Rating?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: I thought that if I could show my stuff a bit more, I could get through the rating process safely.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: But I never thought that... *sigh* Please, help me get my map and Adventurer Handbook back.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: I need to be more careful in future...
